topicTitle: PyQtGraph — fast scientific plotting in Python
courseLine: Official docs · Qt integration, performance, images, ROI tools, and real-time data

prompts.title: Orientation: what PyQtGraph is and how it fits with PyQt vs PySide
prompts.query: I am new to PyQtGraph. Explain what problem it solves versus Matplotlib for interactive scientific GUIs, how it relates to Qt (PyQt5/6 vs PySide2/6), typical install choices, and a minimal mental model: PlotWidget, GraphicsView, Scene, and Items. Call out common beginner mistakes (wrong Qt binding mix, missing event loop).

prompts.title: First interactive plot: PlotWidget, pens, and clearing/replacing data
prompts.query: Walk me through a minimal PyQtGraph example: create a Qt window with a PlotWidget, plot y vs x with a pen, set axis labels and title, and update the curve in a loop or button handler. Explain when to use plot() return values versus keeping a PlotDataItem reference for setData().

prompts.title: Performance: large arrays, downsampling, clip-to-view, and connect modes
prompts.query: Teach PyQtGraph performance patterns for plotting millions of points: auto-downsampling, clip-to-view, decimation, choosing connect='finite' or 'pairs', and when OpenGL line plots help versus CPU paths. Give practical rules of thumb and a checklist when plots feel laggy.

prompts.title: Scatter plots, symbol brushes, and error bars
prompts.query: Show how to build publication-style scatter plots in PyQtGraph: ScatterPlotItem with symbol size/brush/pen, per-point colors or sizes, and error bars (horizontal and vertical). Compare to using multiple PlotDataItem curves when data is dense.

prompts.title: Images: ImageItem, colormap/lookup tables, and levels (contrast)
prompts.query: Explain PyQtGraph image display for 2D numpy arrays: ImageItem basics, setting colormap/LUT, adjusting levels for contrast, handling NaNs, and axis scaling so pixels look square. Mention when ImageView is the right widget versus a raw PlotItem + ImageItem.

prompts.title: ImageView: linked histogram, ROI, and time-axis stacks
prompts.query: Teach the ImageView widget workflow: integrated histogram/levels UI, ROI overlays for inspecting regions, and common patterns for 3D stacks (time or z). Include tips for large stacks (lazy updates, downsampling on load, memory pitfalls).

prompts.title: Axes: ticks, log scales, SI prefixes, and multiple y-axes
prompts.query: How do I customize axes in PyQtGraph? Cover AxisItem tick strings, log scaling, disabling auto-range for one axis, linking X ranges across PlotItems, and patterns for dual y-axes or stacked plots using GraphicsLayout.

prompts.title: Regions, infinite lines, and ROI items for measurement UIs
prompts.query: Design an interactive measurement UI with PyQtGraph: LinearRegionItem for selecting ranges, InfiniteLine for cursors/thresholds, and ROI subclasses for rectangles/ellipses. Explain signals for region changes, how to read selected data from numpy arrays, and how to keep ROI coordinates consistent with image transforms.

prompts.title: Legends, labels, and managing many series cleanly
prompts.query: Show best practices for plots with many curves: LegendItem setup, naming series, toggling visibility, color palettes that remain distinguishable, and organizing code so updates remain readable as complexity grows.

prompts.title: Real-time data: timers, threading, and safe UI updates from acquisition
prompts.query: I am streaming measurements into a Qt GUI using PyQtGraph. Explain a safe architecture: acquisition thread or asyncio worker, queueing samples, updating PlotDataItem with setData on the GUI thread, limiting update rate, and avoiding GIL stalls. Include a minimal pattern using QTimer versus signal/slot from worker threads.

prompts.title: OpenGL plotting: when it helps, limitations, and setup notes
prompts.query: When should I enable OpenGL in PyQtGraph (useOpenGL) for line/scatter plots? Summarize trade-offs, platform/driver caveats, items that do not translate cleanly to GL, and how to fall back to CPU rendering for problematic systems.

prompts.title: Export: screenshots, vector output, and saving arrays from ROIs
prompts.query: Describe practical export workflows from PyQtGraph plots: exporting the scene to PNG/PDF/SVG where supported, capturing widgets at fixed DPI, and exporting processed data (selected ROI windows, downsampled traces) to CSV/NPZ from the same UI.
